The structure of Ti4Fe12N16 (reduced formula TiFe3N4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119) with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Fe and Ti centers coordinated by six N neighbors in octahedral motifs, while N centers show three- or four-coordinate environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Fe octahedra and between Fe and Ti octahedra, with additional edge-sharing between Fe octahedra and between Fe and Ti octahedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
